decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft reusable default unless the current request states it as mandatory. Do not infer destination, dates, price, balcony, ocean view, or indoor versus outdoor pool type.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels with a pool, hot tub, and exercise facilities.
decisions.condition: When selecting or evaluating hotel options.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize hotel properties with a pool, hot tub, and exercise access, and verify that the amenities are available.
decisions.exception_condition: If a current trip prioritizes a different tradeoff or no suitable property provides the full amenity cluster, ask whether a substitute or omission is acceptable.
decisions.name: Prefer amenity-rich hotel properties with pool, hot tub, and exercise access
decisions.preference_value: Prefers hotels that provide a pool, a hot tub, and a place to exercise, ideally a fitness center.
decisions.rationale: Repeated, strongly grounded hotel-selection preference across three conversations. The evidence consistently supports prioritizing a pool, hot tub, and exercise access, while variation in wording supports retaining it as a soft reusable default rather than inferring unrelated property attributes.

decisions.boundary_condition: Do not let this preference override stronger trip-specific constraints such as location, room or bed setup, price or class limits, or explicitly stated must-have amenities.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.condition: When searching for or choosing a hotel.
decisions.default_action: Favor properties advertising free breakfast when otherwise suitable options are being compared.
decisions.exception_condition: If no otherwise suitable hotel includes free breakfast, or the current request frames breakfast tentatively, ask whether a property without it is acceptable rather than rejecting suitable options outright.
decisions.name: Prefers hotels with free breakfast
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast; breakfast quality is a plus when known, but the reusable default should remain soft rather than absolute.
decisions.rationale: Free breakfast recurs across three separate hotel conversations with mixed strength, from tentative interest to an explicit preference. This supports a longitudinal soft ranking preference without making breakfast an absolute requirement.
